messages:
dmitri: quick async standup — what I did: merged kernel prefetch + microbatch alignment PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/432). ran a 1h warmup perf run against canary pool (slotting=adaptive).

What I saw: overall throughput up ~6% but p99 jumps at ~30m mark for 2 shards (~1800ms -> 4.2s). suspect KV hotset eviction pattern + slot steal.

Blockers: need better trace around kv-evict and batch slot migration; current logs don't correlate req ids to slot handoff. also want a quick review on PR 432 (perf/edgecases) before progressing rollout.

Today: add request-id propagation in prefetcher, capture KV evict trace, run a 2h soak with deterministic workload, and try an aggressive backoff on prefetch for long sequences. cc @alice for rollout gating and @carla for kv thresholds.

alice: saw the p99 spikes in the dashboard too. please post p95/p99 time series and the canary pool id. also would help to see heap/GC stats at the spike times.

ben: pinged for review on PR 432. can take a look after standup. also, did you run with slot_preempt=false for the test? that kills the fairness path and isolates batch packing.

carla: interesting — when we hit similar symptoms in q4, evict churn + full GC combo caused long tails. lowering kv.warmup_max_keys and raising evict_threshold helped. can we try KV config: 
```
kv.warmup_max_keys=12000
kv.evict_threshold=0.85
kv.prefetch_backoff_ms=50
```
run on a single canary node and watch.

ellie: I wrote a tiny reproducer that sends long-seq requests with overlapping prefixes; it triggers slot steal reliably. gist: https://gist.github.com/ellie/2c9a0f9. runs in ~30s. can attach to your canary if you want to reproduce live.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: canary/runtime:v2.14 pushed to pool-phi-3 at 2024-11-05T09:12:00Z.

dmitri: thanks — will run ellie's repro against pool-phi-3 after adding richer traces. ben: slot_preempt=false was not used, good call. I'll toggle it for an isolate run.

ben: quick nit on PR 432 — small comment in the prefetch loop about the retry sleep. otherwise LGTM from perf perspective.

carla: happy to run the KV-config experiment this afternoon (ETA 45m). will report p50/p95/p99 + evict counts.

dmitri: if carla can run that, I can focus on request-id propagation and the trace join. anyone else able to review the PR so we can merge after the config test?

alice: I can do a quick security/compat check on the PR (token propagation changes) in ~1h.

ellie: pairing offer — I can help add the trace join (familiar with the tracer lib).

dmitri: awesome. pairing with ellie then. will post short summary + link to the trace query after the soak.

ben: thanks all. flagging this thread for follow-up: if p99 drop isn't resolved by EOD, open a postmortem-lite and rollback. :thumbsup:

carla: running now, will ping with numbers.

alice: noted — will block rollout until p99 goes back under threshold.

ops-bot: reminder: oncall is jen for the window 09:00-17:00 UTC.

dmitri: cool. next async check-in in ~2h or when carla posts results. cheers.
